segments.name: Pool and spa
segments.description: Retail and e-commerce sales of pool and spa care products and services to residential and commercial customers in the United States.
segments.evidence: We manage our business activities on a consolidated basis and operate as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Residential consumers, pool professionals and commercial property operators pay for pool and spa products and services through retail locations and e-commerce.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our revenue in the United States by providing pool related goods and services to our customers through a variety of channels.
